value.rationale: This resolves negatively one direction of a specifically published dependence conjecture, using a smooth strict Archimedean copula rather than a singular or non-Archimedean pathology. It shows that global quadrant dependence alone cannot support PMI-based reflected-density and concordance/model-selection inferences for the full Archimedean class. The exact generator, analytic PQD proof, and rigorous single-point PMI obstruction are natural and reusable; the opposite implication remains open.
